'''Riileb''' was the name of the native language of the [[Riileb (species)|Riileb]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Riileb/Legends|same name]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The Riileb were also capable of speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]], but whilst doing so would revert back to their native tongue occasionaly if shocked. One phrase used in the language was ''krazsch''.<ref name="RwD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Riileb language was first spoken in the short story "[[Rendezvous with Destiny]]" written by [[Charlene Newcomb]], which was published in [[1995]] in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|sixth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' series of ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement books published by [[West End Games]]. It was then used again in a prequel story to Rendezvous with Destiny also by Newcomb titled "[[Passages]]," which was published in the same year in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 7|following issue]] of the Adventure Journal.
